features.name: Water
features.does: Today's ring against a goal worked out from your weight, the day's heat and your steps; glass, mug, bottle, pint, any amount or your own cups; week and month chart; streaks; take back any drink.
features.note: Kept on the phone only. Nudges come only while Ghosty is open.

features.name: Water nudges
features.does: A nudge only when you're behind for the time of day, only inside your nudge hours, never in your quiet hours, and none once you're on track.
features.note: Nothing comes while the phone is locked, because that would mean sending your water to the brain.

features.name: Sleep
say: I slept 7 and a half hours
how did I sleep this week?
features.does: GOING TO BED, then I'M UP keeps the night, or tap last night's hours; a goal; a chart; streaks.

features.name: Steps
features.does: Add today's steps by tap or by voice against a goal; days from a Health export fill in on their own.
features.note: The phone can't count steps live in the browser, so they come from you or from the Health export.

features.name: Weight
features.does: Kilos, stone or pounds; the trend against two weeks before; BMI from your height as a first estimate; a weight to aim for.

features.name: Mood
features.does: One tap a day from Awful to Great, with the week and month on a chart.
features.note: "I feel low" on its own still goes to Ghosty as a conversation, never as a number.

features.name: Count my reps
features.does: The camera counts squats, push-ups or star jumps on the phone and says each one.

features.name: Running coach
features.does: The phone's GPS while the screen is on; pace and distance each kilometre; only the totals reach the brain.

features.name: Breathe
features.does: Box or 4-7-8 breathing with a circle and a buzz.

features.name: Stretch set
features.does: Eight stretches with a timer.

features.name: My Health week
features.does: Reads the Apple Health export on the phone, even a huge one; shows the week's steps and sleep and adds them to the trackers.
features.note: Needs a manual export from the Health app each time.

features.name: Kitchen timers
features.does: Several named timers at once, ringing with a sound and a buzz.
features.note: They ring only while Ghosty is open.

features.name: Shopping list
say: add milk and eggs to the list
features.does: Add by voice, tick things off, share it as text.
features.note: Kept in your brain, so it needs a signal.

features.name: Meal plan
features.does: The week's seven dinners; tonight's shows in the Brief.
features.note: Kept in your brain. Plain text: no recipe link, no shopping list made from the plan.

features.name: Pantry
features.does: Fridge, freezer and cupboard with use-by dates; use-soon first; USED UP can put it on the shopping list.
features.note: No barcode scan on the pantry yet.

features.name: Recipes
say: how do I make a chicken curry?
features.does: Your own recipes beside Ghosty's twelve, ordered by what's in your pantry; scale the servings; cook step by step with timers; add what's missing to shopping; put it on tonight's plan.
features.note: No importing a recipe from a web page yet.

features.name: Dinner ideas and fridge photo
say: what can I make with chicken and rice?
features.does: Three dinners from what you have, from a free recipe site or Ghosty's list.

features.name: Oven, conversions, portions
features.does: Answers on the phone.

features.name: Safer walk
features.does: Routes scored against public police street reports, and the last train or bus home.

features.name: Nearby
features.does: Car parks, toilets, cash, water refills and what's open now, from public maps.

features.name: My car
say: I parked on Cannon Street until 3pm
features.does: Keeps the spot and the time; a reminder 15 minutes before the ticket runs out; the time left; WALK ME BACK TO IT in Maps.

features.name: Lost
features.does: The nearest saved place, the nearest station and the way, with one tap.

features.name: Split a fare
say: taxi £48, I paid, between me, Sam and Jo
features.does: Who owes whom; nothing is paid or sent.

features.name: Body card at Home
features.does: Today's water and last night's sleep, plus the week's active days.

upward.idea: Water nudges on a locked phone, kept private
upward.why: Nudges arrive even when Ghosty is closed, without your water ever leaving the phone.
upward.builds_on: Water nudges, and the phone's existing push channel (send only the 'nudge now' times, never the amounts)

upward.why: Coffee, tea and juice count towards hydration; caffeine after a set hour is flagged gently; alcohol units across the week, all as first estimates.
upward.builds_on: Water's cups and words (beer and coffee are already recognised, just not counted)

upward.idea: A sleep score and a bedtime coach
upward.why: Regularity, duration and debt in one number; a wind-down nudge timed from your own average bedtime.
upward.builds_on: The Sleep tracker's nights and the nudge machinery

upward.why: One Sunday card: water, sleep, steps, weight trend and mood side by side, with the week's best day.
upward.builds_on: The five trackers' charts and the Home card

upward.why: "You sleep 40 minutes longer on days you walk 8,000+": only from his own numbers, said as a pattern, never advice.
upward.builds_on: The trackers' history on the phone

upward.why: The camera already sees the joints; it can say "go a little deeper" or "keep your back straight" as each rep lands.
A 6-week plan that steps squats, push-ups and runs up as you hit them.
upward.builds_on: Reps, the running coach and the brain's workout log

upward.why: Every saved run as a route on the phone's own map, with pace bands and personal bests.
upward.builds_on: The running coach (the route already stays on the phone)

upward.why: Paste a recipe link and it lands in your book with ingredients and steps split out.
upward.builds_on: Recipes, and the brain's page reader

upward.idea: Meal plan that writes the shopping list
upward.why: Plan the week from your recipes, then one tap puts everything missing from the pantry on the list.
upward.builds_on: Meal plan, Recipes, Pantry and Shopping

upward.idea: Pantry by barcode and by receipt
upward.why: Scan a packet or photograph a receipt and the items land in the pantry with a guessed use-by.
upward.builds_on: Pantry, the brain's barcode reader and the Lens's text reading

upward.why: Say "next" or "back" with messy hands; each step is read aloud and a timer starts when one is named.
upward.builds_on: Recipes' step-by-step cooking and the voice

upward.why: A line or tags (work, family, slept badly) with the mood, then a month view of what tends to come with good days.

sideways.why: Take-it reminders with a taken/skipped log and a refill countdown, kept on the phone.
sideways.builds_on: Water nudges' hours and quiet-hours logic, and the trackers' storage

sideways.why: Separate rings with weekly units and a cut-off time.
sideways.builds_on: The tracker engine (one more tracker each)

sideways.why: Start and stop a fast with its streak and history.
sideways.builds_on: Sleep's GOING TO BED / I'M UP timing

sideways.why: Waist, chest and arms with their own trends.
Log headaches, pain and allergies with time and severity, then export one tidy page for an appointment (never a diagnosis).
sideways.builds_on: The tracker engine and the documents export

sideways.why: Sets, reps and weights per exercise with personal bests.
sideways.builds_on: Reps and the brain's workout log

sideways.idea: Calorie and protein estimate per meal
sideways.why: From his own recipes' ingredients, as a first estimate, with a daily total.
sideways.builds_on: Recipes' ingredient lines and the barcode reader's nutrition

sideways.why: Cooked food with an eat-by day and a reminder.
sideways.builds_on: Pantry's use-by lists and the brain's leftovers action

sideways.why: Scale one recipe for the week, split it into portions and put them in the freezer section.

sideways.idea: Outdoor walk planner by weather and daylight
sideways.why: "Best hour for a walk today" from the public forecast, sunset and air quality.
sideways.builds_on: The weather feed (water's heat) and Outside

sideways.why: Name favourite routes and re-run them with times.
sideways.builds_on: The running coach and the safer walk

sideways.why: Each parking session with what it cost, monthly totals.
sideways.builds_on: My car and the money pack

cross.idea: Meal plan and shopping list costed
cross.why: Each week's shop gets a budget line, and spending on groceries is compared with what was planned.
The Brief opens with last night's sleep and today's water goal, and a heavy diary day gets an earlier wind-down nudge.

cross.idea: Fridge and pantry by pointing the Lens
cross.why: Point the Lens at the fridge and the pantry updates itself; point it at a packet and its use-by is read.

cross.idea: Voice everywhere in the kitchen and the body screens
cross.why: More ways to say each thing ("chuck a pint in", "how's my water looking"), all reaching the right tracker.
The Coach builds training plans that write straight into the reps and run trackers.
Plan dinners around people you've introduced (their likes kept in your own notes), with a group shopping list.
